_notice: FICTIONAL. This study, its sites, its staff and its visit schedule are invented for demonstration. It is NOT a ClinicalTrials.gov record and must never be presented as one. Its identifier is deliberately not an NCT number.
briefTitle: SIMULATED: Harborview Adjuvant Endocrine Therapy Adherence Study
officialTitle: SIMULATED STUDY FIXTURE, A Demonstration Protocol Used Only to Exercise Mozaic's Participation Preview and Coordinator Workflow
briefSummary: This is a fictional study fixture. It exists so the demonstration can show a complete visit schedule, a site-confirmed travel burden, and a coordinator answering a logistical question, none of which are reliably available in public registry records. No real participant may enroll and no real site is described.
eligibilityText:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 to 75 years at the time of consent.
* Histologically confirmed hormone receptor positive, HER2 negative breast cancer.
* Currently prescribed adjuvant endocrine therapy for at least 3 months.
* ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
* Able to attend study visits at the Cambridge site.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Metastatic (stage IV) disease.
* Prior participation in an adherence-focused behavioral trial within the last 12 months.
* Active second malignancy requiring treatment.

visitSchedule.notes: Durations are scheduled clinic time only. Waiting time, unscheduled procedures and travel delays are excluded from the totals Mozaic calculates.

knownLogistics.compensationText: Participants receive $50 per completed on-site visit. Payment accrues per visit and does not depend on completing the entire study.

coordinator.displayName: R. Alvarez, Research Coordinator (SIMULATED STAFF ACCOUNT)

cannedAnswers.answer: Parking is validated at the Harborview garage for all scheduled study visits, so there is no out-of-pocket parking cost. This is not stated in the study's public listing, which is why it needs to be asked. Mileage is not reimbursed.
cannedAnswers.citation: Site policy confirmed by coordinator on 2026-09-02 (fictional fixture).

cannedAnswers.answer: The study does not reimburse mileage. The site can arrange a rideshare voucher for participants who tell us in advance that travel is a barrier. Please flag this on your inquiry and we will set it up before the screening visit.

cannedAnswers.answer: All four on-site visits can be scheduled starting at 7:30am, which most participants find easier to fit around work. Visit windows are +/- 7 days except the screening visit.
